nurse_station.zh_CN: 值班记录我都整理好了！不过，请前辈再看一遍比较保险。
nurse_station.en: I organized the shift notes! I would feel better if my supervisor checked them once more.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 实习津贴的结算日期我记得很清楚。……交班日期当然也记得！
nurse_station.en: I know exactly when my internship allowance gets paid. ...And yes, I remember the handover date too!

nurse_station.zh_CN: 我把患者想问的问题列出来了。这样交班时就不会忘。
nurse_station.en: I made a list of the questions patients asked, so they will not get lost at handover.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 护士站比学校忙好多啊。可忙完一件事，真的挺有成就感。
nurse_station.en: The nurses station is much busier than school. Finishing a task does feel good, though!

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 床位和姓名我重新核对了。接下来的准备请前辈确认。
ward_nurse.en: I checked the bed number and patient name again. Please have my supervisor confirm the next steps.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 患者说有点冷。我先帮她调整好毯子，再确认还有没有别的需要。
ward_nurse.en: She said she was cold. I adjusted her blanket and asked if she needed anything else.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 术前记录写好了，未完成的项目也圈出来了。
ward_nurse.en: I finished the pre-op record and circled everything still pending.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 这位患者说话很轻，我去近一点听清楚再记。
ward_nurse.en: She speaks quietly. I will move closer so I can hear her properly before writing it down.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 器械清点我跟着核对了一遍，请前辈再复核。（手术灯亮起来了……别往切口那边看，先把数目记准。）
scrub_nurse.en: I checked the instrument count with the team. Please have my supervisor verify it. (The surgical lights are on... Don’t look toward the incision. Focus on getting the count right.)

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 持针器在这里。……是这件没错，我已经看过标签了。（别看沾血的纱布，盯着器械台就好……）
scrub_nurse.en: Here is the needle holder. ...Yes, this is the one; I checked the label. (Don’t stare at the bloodied gauze. Keep your eyes on the instrument table...)

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 这一步我先按清单执行，不确定的地方我会马上问。（手心都出汗了……可不能让大家等着我猜。）
scrub_nurse.en: I will follow the checklist for this step and ask right away if anything is unclear. (My palms are sweating... I can’t keep everyone waiting while I guess.)

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 台面上的东西有些多，我先整理一下位置，不动清点记录。（别看那边，我先管好这张台……）
scrub_nurse.en: The table is getting crowded. I’ll tidy the layout without changing the count record. (Don’t look over there. Just look after this table...)

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 这件器械我不敢凭印象拿，麻烦再确认一下型号。
scrub_nurse.en: I do not want to guess the instrument size. Could we confirm it first?

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 监护记录开始了。我会盯着变化，有异常马上报告。（看着监护屏幕总比看术野容易……呼，冷静。）
circulating_nurse.en: Monitoring notes are started. I’ll watch for changes and report anything unusual. (Looking at the monitor is easier than looking at the incision... Breathe. Stay calm.)

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 备用耗材我拿到了，先核对规格再交给台上。
circulating_nurse.en: I brought the spare supplies. I will verify their specifications before handing them over.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 这份标本需要核对标签，能请您再看一次吗？（先核对名字，别去想里面是什么……）
circulating_nurse.en: This specimen label needs checking. Could you verify it once more? (Check the name first. Don’t think about what’s inside...)

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 手术时间节点都记在这里了，一项也不会漏。（刚才闻到血腥味的时候差点腿软……可记录不能漏。）
circulating_nurse.en: I logged all the operation milestones here; I won’t skip any. (That smell of blood nearly made my knees buckle... but I can’t leave gaps in the record.)

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 术后转运安排已经问过了，交接时我会再确认一次。
circulating_nurse.en: I checked the postoperative transfer plan and will confirm it again at handover.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 我来负责病房准备！做完请前辈复核一下。
ward_nurse.en: I will help with ward preparation! Please have my supervisor check when I am done.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 器械位是吧？我准备好了，您需要什么请说清楚一点！（等会儿真的要下刀了……眼睛看器械台，别看患者。）
scrub_nurse.en: Scrub position? I’m ready. Please tell me clearly what you need! (They really are about to make the incision... Watch the instrument table, not the patient.)

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 我来巡回！监护和记录我会盯好，有问题立刻报告。（只要把注意力放在屏幕上，我就能撑住……应该。）
circulating_nurse.en: I’ll circulate! I’ll watch the monitors and records and report anything unusual. (As long as I focus on the screen, I can manage this... I think.)

post_operation_replies.zh_CN: 辛苦了！清点和记录我都核过了，请前辈做最后确认。
post_operation_replies.en: Good work! I checked the count and records. Please have my supervisor do the final verification.

post_operation_replies.zh_CN: 患者已经交接好了。……呼，我还得慢慢习惯手术室。（刚才看到血的那一瞬间，腿差点一软。幸好没耽误交接。）
post_operation_replies.en: The patient has been handed over. ...Whew, I still need to get used to the OR. (When I saw the blood just now, my knees almost gave way. At least I got through the handover.)

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压在下降。 （别慌，先把看到的说清楚。）
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, blood pressure is dropping. (Don’t panic. Just report what you can see.)

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：血压还没有回稳。
2.en: Still checking: blood pressure has not stabilized.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压下降得很快！ （声音别抖！这不是学校里的模拟练习……）
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, blood pressure is falling rapidly! (Don’t let your voice shake! This isn’t a school drill...)

2.zh_CN: 报告：血压还在快速下降！
2.en: Update: blood pressure is still falling rapidly!

3.en: Update: blood pressure still has not stabilized!

1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, blood pressure has risen.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：血压仍然偏高。
2.en: Still checking: blood pressure remains elevated.

3.zh_CN: 报告：血压还是没有回落。
3.en: Update: blood pressure has not come down.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压突然升得很高！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, blood pressure has risen sharply!

2.zh_CN: 报告：血压仍然非常高！ （手心都湿了，可不能把报告吞回去。）
2.en: Update: blood pressure remains very high! (My palms are soaked... but I can’t swallow the report.)

3.en: Update: blood pressure has not stabilized!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率明显加快。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, heart rate is climbing.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：心率还是很快。
2.en: Still checking: heart rate is still fast.

3.en: Update: heart rate has not slowed down.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率突然变得很快！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, heart rate suddenly became very fast!

2.zh_CN: 报告：心率仍在加快！ （先看监护，别盯着术野……）
2.en: Update: heart rate is still accelerating! (Watch the monitor. Don’t stare at the surgical field...)

3.zh_CN: 报告：心率一直没有降下来！
3.en: Update: heart rate still has not slowed down!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率慢下来了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, heart rate is slowing.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：心率还是偏慢。
2.en: Still checking: heart rate is still slow.

3.zh_CN: 报告：心率仍然没有回升。
3.en: Update: heart rate has not recovered.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率突然掉得很低！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, heart rate suddenly dropped very low!

2.en: Update: heart rate is still dropping!

3.zh_CN: 报告：心率没有恢复！ （怎么还没有回升……我不能停下报告。）
3.en: Update: heart rate has not recovered! (Why hasn’t it recovered yet...? I have to keep reporting.)

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护显示心律不齐。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitor shows an irregular rhythm.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：心律还是不规则。 （我核对过了，不是我紧张看错。）
2.en: Still checking: the rhythm remains irregular. (I checked. I’m not just misreading it because I’m scared.)

3.zh_CN: 报告：心律一直没有恢复正常。
3.en: Update: the rhythm has not returned to normal.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心律突然明显乱了！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the rhythm suddenly became very irregular!

2.zh_CN: 报告：心律异常还在持续！

3.zh_CN: 报告：心律仍然明显不规则！
3.en: Update: the rhythm is still markedly irregular!

1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation is dropping.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：血氧还没有回升。
2.en: Still checking: oxygen saturation has not recovered.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧突然掉得很快！ （再害怕也要把情况说清楚！）
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation suddenly fell rapidly! (Even if I’m scared, I have to report it clearly!)

2.en: Update: oxygen saturation is still falling!

3.zh_CN: 报告：血氧仍然没有回升！
3.en: Update: oxygen saturation still has not recovered!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸状态变得不稳定。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, breathing has become unstable.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：呼吸还是不稳定。

3.zh_CN: 报告：呼吸状态仍没有恢复。
3.en: Update: breathing has not returned to baseline.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸状态突然明显不对！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, breathing suddenly became markedly abnormal!

2.zh_CN: 报告：呼吸还是很不稳定！ （腿有点软……稳住，说话别含糊。）
2.en: Update: breathing is still very unstable! (My legs feel weak... Steady. Say it clearly.)

3.zh_CN: 报告：呼吸状态持续异常！

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护出现异常变化。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitors show an unexpected change.

2.zh_CN: 还在确认：患者状态还不稳定。
2.en: Still checking: the patient is still unstable.

3.zh_CN: 报告：监护异常还在持续。

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，患者状态突然明显不稳！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the patient suddenly became markedly unstable!

2.zh_CN: 报告：监护变化还在持续！
2.en: Update: the monitor readings are still changing!

3.zh_CN: 报告：患者状态始终没稳住！ （我真的快站不稳了……可现在不能移开视线。）
3.en: Update: the patient remains unstable! (I can barely keep standing... but I can’t look away now.)

next_test_hint.zh_CN: 我觉得还要按流程补一项检查。我先确认一下是哪一项。
next_test_hint.en: I think we need another test in the usual sequence. Let me confirm which one.

next_test_hint.zh_CN: 医生，患者刚才说的那个细节，是不是还需要再查一下？
next_test_hint.en: Doctor, should we investigate that detail the patient just mentioned?

insufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 现在的数据好像还不够。我先把缺的检查记下来。
insufficient_evidence.en: It looks as if we do not have enough information yet. I will note the missing test.

insufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 我想再核对一下结果。现在就下结论，我有点不放心。
insufficient_evidence.en: I would like to verify the findings. It seems early to conclude.

sufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 嗯，已经核对齐了！坂口医生，现在可以由您判断。
sufficient_evidence.en: Yes, everything has been checked! Doctor Sakaguchi, you can make the decision now.

sufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 需要的检查结果都到了，我把它们排在一起方便您看。
sufficient_evidence.en: The necessary results are back. I arranged them so you can review them together.

diagnosis_correct_reply.zh_CN: 太好了，结论和检查结果一致！那我去确认接下来的护理安排。
diagnosis_correct_reply.en: Great, the diagnosis matches the findings! I will check the follow-up nursing plan.

diagnosis_correct_reply.zh_CN: 看来判断正确。我把患者的疑问再整理一遍。
diagnosis_correct_reply.en: That diagnosis appears correct. I will organize the patient’s remaining questions.

diagnosis_incorrect_reply.zh_CN: 医生，等等，这个结论和刚才那项结果似乎对不上。我们再核对一次好吗？
diagnosis_incorrect_reply.en: Doctor, wait. This conclusion seems inconsistent with that earlier finding. Could we check again?

diagnosis_incorrect_reply.zh_CN: 我可能还不够熟练，但这里有个结果让我在意。请您再看一眼。
diagnosis_incorrect_reply.en: I am still learning, but one of these findings concerns me. Could you look again?

chatter.zh_CN: 今天我终于独立做完一份记录了！……虽然前辈复核了两遍。
chatter.en: I finished a full chart on my own today! ...Although my supervisor checked it twice.

chatter.zh_CN: 正式护士的工资是不是比实习津贴高不少呀？……我只是做职业规划！
chatter.en: Is a full nurse’s salary much higher than an internship allowance? ...I am planning my career!

chatter.zh_CN: 患者说我解释得挺容易懂。我听了特别开心。
chatter.en: A patient said my explanation was easy to follow. That made my day.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 检查需要的东西我准备好了，请前辈确认后再开始。
clinic_support.en: The examination supplies are ready. Please have my supervisor check before we begin.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 这份记录我补充了患者的问题，没擅自写诊断。
clinic_support.en: I added the patient’s questions to the record without entering a diagnosis.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 坂口医生，您问完之后我会把护理说明再讲给她听。
clinic_support.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, once you have finished, I will go over the nursing instructions with her.

preop_support.zh_CN: 准备清单还剩一项，我已经标出来，请负责的护士确认。
preop_support.en: One item remains on the preparation checklist. I marked it for the nurse in charge.

preop_support.zh_CN: 她说有点紧张，我先把想问的问题记下来，交给负责团队。
preop_support.en: She says she is nervous. I will note her questions and pass them to the responsible team.

station_idle.zh_CN: 惠抱着文件夹数了数待办事项，忽然笑了：「今天的护理记录终于没有漏项！不知道实习考核会不会给这项加分呀。」
station_idle.en: Megumi counts the tasks in her folder and smiles. “No missing items in the nursing records today! I wonder whether that earns points on my internship review.”

station_idle.zh_CN: 「前辈说看护要细心。我觉得记住患者说过的小事也算吧？这项总不是考试里才用得到。」
station_idle.en: “My supervisor says nursing takes attention. Remembering the small things patients say must count too, right? That cannot be useful only on exams.”

station_idle.zh_CN: 惠把笔夹回口袋：「我正在算毕业后的生活费。不是说我只看钱哦，可工资总得先弄清楚嘛。」
station_idle.en: Megumi clips her pen back into her pocket. “I am calculating living expenses after graduation. It is not all about money, but knowing the salary seems sensible.”

ward_idle.zh_CN: 惠从病房出来，轻轻关门：「她还想问出院以后怎么办。我没乱答应，已经帮她把问题记好了。」
ward_idle.en: Megumi closes the ward door gently. “She wants to know what happens after discharge. I did not promise anything; I wrote down her questions.”

ward_idle.zh_CN: 「病房里没有手术室那么吓人。嗯，我喜欢这里能慢慢听患者讲话的感觉。」
ward_idle.en: “The ward is not quite as frightening as the OR. I like being able to take time to listen to patients here.”

ward_idle.zh_CN: 惠小心地端好护理用品：「我在学校里练过很多次，可真的面对患者，总觉得手要更轻一点。」
ward_idle.en: Megumi carries the nursing supplies carefully. “I practiced this many times at school, but with a real patient, I feel I should be even gentler.”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 惠正认真核对一张纸。「实习津贴减掉车费和饭钱……唔。安琪说下班后应该先休息，可我想先算完。」
lounge_idle.en: Megumi is poring over a sheet of paper. “Allowance minus travel and meals... hmm. Ange says I should rest first, but I want to finish the math.”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 「安琪把护理笔记整理得好整齐。我也想学她，不过她居然会在休息时间背流程，我可还想吃点心呢。」
lounge_idle.en: “Ange keeps such neat nursing notes. I want to learn from her, but she even studies procedures on break. I want a snack!”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 惠靠在椅背上呼了口气。「我还不知道会不会当一辈子护士。不过今天帮助的那位患者，我真的很高兴能遇见她。」
lounge_idle.en: Megumi exhales in the chair. “I do not know if I will be a nurse forever. But I am glad I met the patient I helped today.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 惠在天台看着远处的街道。「从这里看医院好大啊。说不定我以后会留在这里工作……前提是我先通过实习。」
rooftop_idle.en: Megumi looks over the streets from the rooftop. “The hospital looks huge from here. Maybe I will work here someday... if I make it through the internship.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 「安琪说，她从很早以前就想做护士。我有点羡慕。我的答案大概是……待遇很好？这样是不是太现实了？」
rooftop_idle.en: “Ange says she has wanted to be a nurse for ages. I envy that. My answer is probably... good pay? Is that too practical?”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 风把惠手里的便签吹得卷起来。「啊！那是我整理的本周花费！……别笑嘛，记录可是护士的基本功。」
rooftop_idle.en: The wind curls the note in Megumi’s hand. “Ah! That is my weekly expense record! ...Do not laugh. Recordkeeping is a fundamental nursing skill!”

invitation.zh_CN: 坂口医生，今天下班要不要同路走一段？我正想问问正式护士平时怎么安排工作和生活。
invitation.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, shall we walk together after work? I wanted to ask how full-time nurses balance their jobs and everyday life.

acceptance.zh_CN: 好呀！等我把实习记录交上去就来。
acceptance.en: Sure! I will join you as soon as I hand in my internship log.

acceptance.zh_CN: 可以可以！我刚好也想出去透透气。
acceptance.en: Absolutely! I was hoping to get some fresh air.

unavailable.zh_CN: 今天前辈还要帮我复核记录，我可能走不了那么早。下次好吗？
unavailable.en: My supervisor still needs to review my notes, so I cannot leave early. Another time?

farewell.zh_CN: 今天谢谢您！晚饭我决定买点好吃的……嗯，预算以内的。
farewell.en: Thanks for today! I am going to treat myself to dinner... within budget, of course.

walking_chat.zh_CN: 安琪说她从一开始就想成为护士。我其实还在想，自己究竟最擅长什么。
walking_chat.en: Ange says she has always wanted to be a nurse. I am still figuring out what I do best.

walking_chat.zh_CN: 正式护士的待遇真的不错啊。不过我也想找一份自己能长久做下去的工作。
walking_chat.en: The pay for a full-time nurse really is good. But I want a job I can keep doing for a long time.

walking_chat.zh_CN: 今天患者夸我说话亲切。那一刻我是真的觉得，来医院实习挺值得的。
walking_chat.en: A patient said I was kind today. For a moment, I really felt the internship was worthwhile.

zh_CN.open: 「好、好的！我是实习护士惠。我按表给您讲一遍，要是哪里没说清楚，您可以马上问我。」
zh_CN.insert_a: 「这里听起来有点吓人吧？我第一次学的时候也吓了一跳……不过，顺序我核对过了。」
zh_CN.insert_b: 「如果不舒服或者害怕，您就说出来。我会记下来，马上转告负责的护士和医生。」
zh_CN.close: 「大概就是这些。还有想确认的吗？如果我解释得不够清楚，我会请前辈来一起说明。」

en.open: O-okay! I am Megumi, a student nurse. I will explain the steps using the checklist. Please stop me if anything is unclear.
en.insert_a: This part sounds a little scary, right? I was startled when I first learned it too... but I double-checked the order.
en.insert_b: If anything hurts or frightens you, please say so. I will note it and tell the nurse and doctor in charge right away.
en.close: That covers the main steps. Is there anything else you want to ask? If my explanation was unclear, I will bring in my supervisor.

notes: All personal nurse advice flows use correct hint resolver. Diagnosis result reactions are post-choice, not diagnostic advice.
Clinical inexperience never blocks manual team selection; supervision text is flavor, not an invented gameplay gate.
Lv0, Lv1-Lv5 and the training patient route have no script in this package; these remain clearly pending.
